summary: Release review seals exact source/result HTML, runtime and checker identities; mutations and recovered commits require verified post-review gates.
invariants: Review provider calls and costs remain fenced by their own public admission; the generation worker owns quality.review.
Export may use only the reviewed source revision or the review result revision under the same owner and tenant.
A PASS is derived only from complete full-deck review evidence bound to source/result HTML, render runtime, assets and checker policy.
Mutating review results require deterministic post-review capacity, QID and browser safety validation; source-reflow requires renewed source readback.
A recovered completed mutating task may publish its result revision but cannot manufacture PASS; a sealed recheck transition requires a subsequent full review.
Stale or invalid completed review receipts cannot suppress a replacement review.
forbidden: Bypass blocked review with the development QualityReceiptV3.
Synthesize or relax a quality PASS.
Treat local Windows runtime evidence as production isolation or deployment authorization.
